description: This file defines the EntityStorageSchemaInterface interface for Drupal's entity storage schema handling, including methods to check if schema changes are needed and if data migration is required.

classes.name: EntityStorageSchemaInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity storage schema handler classes, extending EntityTypeListenerInterface, with methods to determine schema changes and data migration needs.

methods.name: requiresEntityStorageSchemaChanges
methods.description: Checks if changes to an entity type require storage schema modifications.

methods.name: requiresEntityDataMigration
methods.description: Checks if existing data would be lost if schema changes are applied, indicating if data migration is necessary.
